meta.title: Clash of Revelation
meta.description: Endless doubts and faith incarnate come together in this final battle.

units.rawText: <size=40>In the Inner Ring of the Tartarus Sector.</size>
units.displayText: In the Inner Ring of the Tartarus Sector.

spans.text: In the Inner Ring of the Tartarus Sector.

units.rawText: The sounds of fighting from outside the door rise and fall. Malkira sits upright on her throne, lovingly caressing her pet Entropic. Her eyes are half-shut, as though she's enjoying beautiful music.
units.displayText: The sounds of fighting from outside the door rise and fall. Malkira sits upright on her throne, lovingly caressing her pet Entropic. Her eyes are half-shut, as though she's enjoying beautiful music.

spans.text: The sounds of fighting from outside the door rise and fall. Malkira sits upright on her throne, lovingly caressing her pet Entropic. Her eyes are half-shut, as though she's enjoying beautiful music.

units.rawText: Do you hear it? This exquisitely designed play... is about to reach its climax.
units.displayText: Do you hear it? This exquisitely designed play... is about to reach its climax.

spans.text: Do you hear it? This exquisitely designed play... is about to reach its climax.

units.rawText: Several screams later, the ruckus outside the door dies down. The pet Entropic cowers in Malkira's arms, its gaze wandering warily between Malkira and the door.
units.displayText: Several screams later, the ruckus outside the door dies down. The pet Entropic cowers in Malkira's arms, its gaze wandering warily between Malkira and the door.

spans.text: Several screams later, the ruckus outside the door dies down. The pet Entropic cowers in Malkira's arms, its gaze wandering warily between Malkira and the door.

units.rawText: Chirp...
units.displayText: Chirp...

spans.text: Chirp...

units.rawText: There, there. Our guest will be here soon.
units.displayText: There, there. Our guest will be here soon.

spans.text: There, there. Our guest will be here soon.

units.rawText: Crash—
units.displayText: Crash—

spans.text: Crash—

units.rawText: Something smashes against the door and the thunderous impact breaks the silence.
units.displayText: Something smashes against the door and the thunderous impact breaks the silence.

spans.text: Something smashes against the door and the thunderous impact breaks the silence.

units.rawText: Chirpchirp...chirpchirp!
units.displayText: Chirpchirp...chirpchirp!

spans.text: Chirpchirp...chirpchirp!

units.rawText: Frightened, the pet Entropic looks at its master and tries to seek shelter, but instead, it sees her hitherto placid face burning with twisted excitement.
units.displayText: Frightened, the pet Entropic looks at its master and tries to seek shelter, but instead, it sees her hitherto placid face burning with twisted excitement.

spans.text: Frightened, the pet Entropic looks at its master and tries to seek shelter, but instead, it sees her hitherto placid face burning with twisted excitement.

units.rawText: Ah... he's here, he's here at last!
units.displayText: Ah... he's here, he's here at last!

spans.text: Ah... he's here, he's here at last!

units.rawText: Malkira rises to her feet and the pet Entropic falls to the ground. It scurries into a shadowy corner, striving to flee the crashing noise that is growing louder and louder.
units.displayText: Malkira rises to her feet and the pet Entropic falls to the ground. It scurries into a shadowy corner, striving to flee the crashing noise that is growing louder and louder.

spans.text: Malkira rises to her feet and the pet Entropic falls to the ground. It scurries into a shadowy corner, striving to flee the crashing noise that is growing louder and louder.

units.rawText: Crash—!
units.displayText: Crash—!

spans.text: Crash—!

units.rawText: <size=40>Crash—!!</size>
units.displayText: Crash—!!

spans.text: Crash—!!

units.rawText: After the third collision, the door is smashed apart and a dark shape falls into the room amidst a shower of rock fragments.
units.displayText: After the third collision, the door is smashed apart and a dark shape falls into the room amidst a shower of rock fragments.

spans.text: After the third collision, the door is smashed apart and a dark shape falls into the room amidst a shower of rock fragments.

units.rawText: It is Caina, impaled through her chest with her own weapon, which nails her to the ground in front of the throne like a javelin.
units.displayText: It is Caina, impaled through her chest with her own weapon, which nails her to the ground in front of the throne like a javelin.

spans.text: It is Caina, impaled through her chest with her own weapon, which nails her to the ground in front of the throne like a javelin.

units.rawText: A figure wielding stars and light follows immediately behind her, holding a pair of purple carcasses that are still dripping light blue liquid from where they have been cut in half. They are dumped beside Caina.
units.displayText: A figure wielding stars and light follows immediately behind her, holding a pair of purple carcasses that are still dripping light blue liquid from where they have been cut in half. They are dumped beside Caina.

spans.text: A figure wielding stars and light follows immediately behind her, holding a pair of purple carcasses that are still dripping light blue liquid from where they have been cut in half. They are dumped beside Caina.

units.rawText: As you wish, I am here to take your life.
units.displayText: As you wish, I am here to take your life.

spans.text: As you wish, I am here to take your life.

units.rawText: Malkira is neither frightened or shaken by this scene. She simply applauds in sincere delight.
units.displayText: Malkira is neither frightened or shaken by this scene. She simply applauds in sincere delight.

spans.text: Malkira is neither frightened or shaken by this scene. She simply applauds in sincere delight.

units.rawText: Clapclapclap—
units.displayText: Clapclapclap—

spans.text: Clapclapclap—

units.rawText: Amazing! Eosphorus, there could be no better finale than this.
units.displayText: Amazing! Eosphorus, there could be no better finale than this.

spans.text: Amazing! Eosphorus, there could be no better finale than this.

units.rawText: As the leader of the Sanctifiers, you led your elites in overcoming all the obstacles and opposition in your way, crushing despair and difficulty, fighting your way through Tartarus to arrive before the Queen's throne.
units.displayText: As the leader of the Sanctifiers, you led your elites in overcoming all the obstacles and opposition in your way, crushing despair and difficulty, fighting your way through Tartarus to arrive before the Queen's throne.

spans.text: As the leader of the Sanctifiers, you led your elites in overcoming all the obstacles and opposition in your way, crushing despair and difficulty, fighting your way through Tartarus to arrive before the Queen's throne.

units.rawText: This magnificent deed has never before been performed in Magrasea! At last, at last. At last!
units.displayText: This magnificent deed has never before been performed in Magrasea! At last, at last. At last!

spans.text: This magnificent deed has never before been performed in Magrasea! At last, at last. At last!

units.rawText: Hehehehe... hahaha—
units.displayText: Hehehehe... hahaha—

spans.text: Hehehehe... hahaha—

units.rawText: <size=40>AHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA—</size>
units.displayText: AHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA—

spans.text: AHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA—

units.rawText: Malkira's laughter is filled with madness. Her tentacles swell and twitch, as though hungry.
units.displayText: Malkira's laughter is filled with madness. Her tentacles swell and twitch, as though hungry.

spans.text: Malkira's laughter is filled with madness. Her tentacles swell and twitch, as though hungry.

units.rawText: Just as her mad laughter reaches its peak, it suddenly stops, becoming an ardent heat instead.
units.displayText: Just as her mad laughter reaches its peak, it suddenly stops, becoming an ardent heat instead.

spans.text: Just as her mad laughter reaches its peak, it suddenly stops, becoming an ardent heat instead.

units.rawText: —At last, you are standing before me.
units.displayText: —At last, you are standing before me.

spans.text: —At last, you are standing before me.

units.rawText: Eosphorus, I have waited too long for this. From the first day the Reverse Tower of Babylon clashed with Tartarus... No, even before that.
units.displayText: Eosphorus, I have waited too long for this. From the first day the Reverse Tower of Babylon clashed with Tartarus... No, even before that.

spans.text: Eosphorus, I have waited too long for this. From the first day the Reverse Tower of Babylon clashed with Tartarus... No, even before that.

units.rawText: I have been looking forward to your arrival ever since the Tartarus Sector was born.
units.displayText: I have been looking forward to your arrival ever since the Tartarus Sector was born.

spans.text: I have been looking forward to your arrival ever since the Tartarus Sector was born.

units.rawText: It is the same for me.
units.displayText: It is the same for me.

spans.text: It is the same for me.

units.rawText: Eosphorus takes a deep breath, and then levels his sword at Malkira.
units.displayText: Eosphorus takes a deep breath, and then levels his sword at Malkira.

spans.text: Eosphorus takes a deep breath, and then levels his sword at Malkira.

units.rawText: The blade gleams with light, glowing like a newborn star, its shining edge extending straight into the abyss.
units.displayText: The blade gleams with light, glowing like a newborn star, its shining edge extending straight into the abyss.

spans.text: The blade gleams with light, glowing like a newborn star, its shining edge extending straight into the abyss.

units.rawText: <size=40><color=red>Malkira, I have come to kill you.</color></size>
units.displayText: Malkira, I have come to kill you.

spans.text: Malkira, I have come to kill you.
